name: Tabs
title: Tabs
summary: Switches between panels of related content on the same page without a page load: underline tabs with counts, pill segmented tabs, vertical tabs and a scrollable mobile row.
whenToUse: Use underline tabs to filter one collection into kinds: Resources page "All / Apps / Radio / Publishing / NFC Cards".
Use segmented (`.nv-seg`) for 2–4 short, equal options: gift frequency, Listen / Read.
Use vertical tabs (`.nv-vtabs`) for a settings-style page with a side list: "Ways to partner".
whenNotToUse: Do not use tabs to go to another page. Use links, Breadcrumbs or AnchorNav for that.
Do not use tabs for more than about 6 options on desktop; use a select or filter chips (`.chip[aria-pressed]`).

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the tablist that names the set: "Resource types". Required for a11y.

props.name: variant
props.description: `underline` filters one collection into kinds; `segmented` is for 2 to 4 short equal options; `vertical` is a side list (max 7).

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called when the selection changes (click, arrow keys, Home, End).

props.name: dark
props.description: Segmented tabs on a dark background (`.nv-seg-dark`).

props.name: scrollable
props.description: Underline tabs: scroll sideways on phones instead of wrapping (`.nv-tabs-scroll`).

props.name: tablistClassName
props.description: Class name for the tablist element (the root `className` goes on the wrapper).

variantNotes: **Underline tab (`.nv-tab`):** 48px tall, 15px/500 `var(--gray-700)`, 28px apart on a `var(--gray-200)` hairline.
**Segmented (`.nv-seg`):** `var(--gray-100)` pill track with 4px padding; 44px buttons; selected is a white pill with a soft shadow. On dark add `.nv-seg-dark` (track `rgba(255,255,255,.08)`).
**Vertical (`.nv-vtab`):** 48px rows, `var(--radius-md)`; hover `var(--off-white)`; selected `var(--blue-tint)` with a 3px inset `var(--horizon-blue)` edge.
**Mobile scroll row (`.nv-tabs-scroll`):** no wrap, `overflow-x:auto`, 16px gutter, 22px gaps, white fade on the right hints more.

states.universal: See rules/states.md for the seven required states and their hooks.

rules: Tabs swap panels in place. Never make a tab navigate to a new URL.
Only the selected underline is Horizon Blue. Never colour unselected tabs blue.
Counts are neutral grey, or blue-tint when selected. Never red.
Keep all tabs at least 44px tall (48px for underline and vertical tabs).
Keep labels on one line (`white-space:nowrap`); on phones scroll the row, never wrap it.
Segmented tabs: 2–4 options of similar length. Vertical tabs: max 7.
Show a disabled tab only when its absence would confuse ("Archive 0"); otherwise hide it.

accessibility: Roving tabindex: only the selected tab has `tabindex="0"`. ← → move between tabs (↑ ↓ for vertical), Home/End jump to the ends.
Mark selection with `aria-selected`, never with colour alone (weight and underline also change).
Give the tablist an `aria-label` that names the set: "Resource types", "Gift frequency".
content: Short nouns in sentence case: "All resources", "Apps", "Radio", "Publishing", "NFC Cards".
Counts are real totals of the items in each panel (preview numbers are samples).
